text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O and Meisho Doto. The wall 
formed by these two was one factor behind 
the worst-case fate that "Parcae" had 
indicated.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur's Record
text_block_list.text:
Both of them pushed past their limits 
during the mock race. If I can't surpass 
even that, I'm going to fall behind.
